column4: dialect-gated: cleat#3571 test, one function per dialect so the SQL Server arm skips on its own (same shape as a-tenants-beat-does-not-queue-behind-the-execution-pool-on-sql-server.tsv). This job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) supplies no SQL Server, so exactly this function skips; it FAILS rather than skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set and the server is unreachable (OpenIsolatedStore pings it). Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestTheStoreMainBuildsForTheHeartbeatPool -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one.
